adjustments.reason: The Maharashtra Pollution Control Board directed the closure of manufacturing operations at the Waluj unit, adding regulatory and operational disruption risk beyond the suggested cut.
Management has a 0/100 promise-delivery score over the last four calls alongside negative 3-year operating cash flow at -0.71x reported profit, warranting a much smaller addition.
Deputy MD Kaizad Bharucha requested cessation effective December 31, 2026 right as Anup Bagchi assumed charge as MD and CEO, adding leadership transition risk to the planned increase.
US FDA approval of ILUMYA for active psoriatic arthritis provides a regulatory and commercial catalyst not yet captured in historical growth numbers.

8d77de0f275b25d8b283.summary: Filings and records warrant trimming the suggested weights for CGPOWER after a pollution-board plant closure order, KAYNES due to 0/100 promise delivery and negative cash conversion, and HDFCBANK amid a Deputy MD exit during its CEO transition. Conversely, SUNPHARMA merits a smaller reduction following US FDA approval for ILUMYA in active psoriatic arthritis.
